explain XXXXX in english without using word XXXXX.

a:

i think that what you want is a way to show the time without using the XXXXX word. you can start with using the %n format specifier which can also accept a time without the XXXXX. 
example: 
%%time

t1 = nanoseconds
j = 0
if t2 < t1 + 1 then j = j + 1 else j = j + 2 
t2 = t2 + 1

print(j)

%n

%n% t1 %n% t2

%n% %n% %n% t2 %n

%n% %n% %n% t1 %n% t2 %n
